Think like a detective: trace what attrition leads to

Your role

Your job as an extern: spot workforce risks early and trace what they lead to.

The pattern

Left alone, attrition can feed itself.

  1. People leave: they quit, retire, or are let go.
  2. Gaps open: new hires fill in and need training.
  3. Pressure rises: the people who stay cover the gaps, and more of them leave.

Try it

Trace one exit from the floor to the business.

  1. An experienced Picker quits.

How to work

Work like a detective.

Ask two questions

Each time someone leaves: Why? And what does it cost the business?

Watch for signs

  • Fatigue
  • Silence
  • Complaints
  • Lots of new hires
